strategy.thesis: Europe's first business-angel network dedicated exclusively to health, pooling healthcare-expert investors to back Biotech, Medtech and e-Health startups from proof-of-concept through to scale-up, targeting raises of roughly €400K-€2M.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Members are healthcare-sector experts (clinicians, industry executives) who join startups' strategic committees post-investment.

summary.en: Angels Santé is Europe's first business-angel network dedicated to health, founded in Paris in 2008, with close to 150 members backing Biotech, Medtech, digital-health and animal-health startups.
summary.local: Angels Santé est le premier réseau de Business Angels en Europe entièrement dédié à la santé, fondé à Paris en 2008, qui soutient des startups en biotech, medtech et santé numérique.

strategy.thesis: A Basel-based, voluntary non-profit business-angel association dedicated to healthcare, matching angel investors with early-stage biotech, medtech and digital-health entrepreneurs and helping bring regulated-market innovations to patients.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Board composed of healthcare-industry veterans (President Achim Diedenhofen and colleagues); portfolio spans gene-transcription therapeutics, cancer diagnostics, immunotherapy, mRNA therapeutics and regenerative medicine.

summary.en: Swiss Health Angels is a Basel-based, non-profit business-angel association focused solely on healthcare, backing biotech, medtech and digital-health startups such as Cellestia, ARTIDIS and Cutiss.
summary.local: Swiss Health Angels ist ein gemeinnütziger Business-Angel-Verein mit Sitz in Basel, der sich ausschliesslich auf Gesundheits-Startups aus Biotech, Medtech und Digital Health konzentriert.

strategy.thesis: A DACH-region network of 30+ seasoned angel investors dedicated to early-stage life-science and healthcare ventures spanning therapeutics/pharma/biotech, diagnostics, digital health/DiGA and medtech; members act as mentors rather than a pooled fund.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Members invest individually; the network itself 'does not manage funds or investment SPVs, and does not appear in cap tables.' Hosts monthly virtual pitch events.

summary.en: Angels4Health is a Germany-centered network of more than 30 angel investors focused exclusively on early-stage life-science and healthcare ventures across therapeutics, diagnostics, digital health and medtech.
summary.local: Angels4Health ist ein Netzwerk von mehr als 30 erfahrenen Angel-Investoren, das sich ausschliesslich auf frühphasige Life-Science- und Gesundheits-Startups konzentriert.

strategy.thesis: A syndicate of clinicians, operators and investors that screens hundreds of deals annually to back pre-seed/seed HealthTech and MedTech founders with clinical and commercial due diligence, co-investing alongside Scottish Enterprise and the Development Bank of Wales.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Members include clinicians who provide clinical due diligence alongside operator/investor deal screening.

summary.en: Pulse Angels is a UK syndicate of clinicians, operators and investors backing pre-seed and seed-stage HealthTech and MedTech founders with £50k-£500k checks, co-investing with public bodies like Scottish Enterprise.

strategy.thesis: A partnership between MedCity, London Business Angels (Newable) and Angels 4 Life Sciences that connects 400+ angels and VCs to healthcare, medtech and life-sciences dealflow, providing matchmaking with university R&D partners and clinical-trial guidance for SEIS/EIS-eligible companies.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Provides matchmaking with university R&D partners and guidance on clinical trials for portfolio companies.

summary.en: Angels in MedCity is a London-based healthcare, medtech and life-sciences angel-investment program connecting 400+ angels/VCs with SEIS/EIS-eligible startups, typically investing £100k-£2m, and has helped founders raise more than £35 million.

strategy.thesis: Spain's first private investment club specialized in biotechnology and health, connecting business angels, industrial groups and family offices to vetted biotech/health deal flow, built on the Capital Cell platform's track record of 124 completed rounds and €109M invested.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Membership includes executives from Spain's leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies; connects Business Angels, industrials and Family Offices.

summary.en: Bio Angels Club is Spain's first business-angel network specialized in the health sector, launched by the Capital Cell platform to connect angels, industrial groups and family offices with biotech and health startups.
summary.local: Bio Angels Club es la primera red de inversores privados especializados en salud de España, que conecta business angels, industriales y family offices con startups de biotecnología y salud.

strategy.thesis: Italy's dedicated life-sciences business-angel network, formed in 2015 by accomplished life-science entrepreneurs to close Italy's biotech early-stage funding gap; leads equity rounds and typically takes board seats in therapeutics, diagnostics, medical-device and digital-health startups.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Members are entrepreneurs, managers and investors with significant Life Sciences experience, including physicians and scientists; most have been founders or senior executives in healthcare companies.

summary.en: Italian Angels for Biotech (IAB) is Italy's dedicated life-sciences angel network, founded in 2015 by life-science entrepreneurs to lead pre-seed/seed equity rounds in therapeutics, diagnostics, medtech and digital health, typically taking board seats.
summary.local: Italian Angels for Biotech (IAB) è la rete di business angel italiana dedicata alle scienze della vita, fondata nel 2015, che guida round di investimento pre-seed e seed in terapie, diagnostica, dispositivi medici e digital health.

strategy.thesis: A curated syndicate of operators, clinicians and scientists that pairs early-stage capital with operational and clinical expertise across European health-tech and deep health-technology startups, explicitly aiming to translate science into patient impact and de-risk deals for later-stage investors.

verification_notes: Founding year and member/portfolio counts not disclosed on the site; HQ city (Berlin) drawn from search-result description rather than an explicit on-site statement.

strategy.thesis: A pan-European deal-by-deal healthtech investment platform that sources and structures rounds in remote monitoring, diagnostics, personalized medicine and healthcare AI, setting up a dedicated SPV per deal for co-investing business angels, family offices and corporate partners, sourced via an EIT Health partnership.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Partnership with EIT Health gives access to healthtech startups across Europe and Israel; originally launched with EIT Health as the first pan-European equity-crowdfunding platform for healthcare before evolving into deal-by-deal SPV investing.

summary.en: Aescuvest is a Frankfurt-based, deal-by-deal healthtech investment platform that began as an EIT Health-partnered equity-crowdfunding site in 2014 and now sets up a dedicated SPV per round to co-invest alongside business angels, family offices and corporates in remote monitoring, diagnostics and personalized-medicine startups.

sources.quote: Aescuvest is a pan-European venture capital firm headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, that specializes in health technology. It started as a crowdfunding platform in 2014 ... For each deal Aescuvest sets up a dedicated Special Purpose Vehicle ... sources, structures, and co-invests in healthtech rounds alongside business angels, family offices, and corporate partners

strategy.thesis: A Rotterdam-based angel network and EIT Health Netherlands country lead that facilitates business-angel financing for chemical, life-sciences, biobased and agrifood startups, with particular focus on ventures linked to universities, academic hospitals and accelerators.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: EIT Health partner and Country Lead for the Netherlands; targets startups linked to universities and academic hospitals.

summary.local: Business Angels Connect is een Rotterdams business angel-netwerk en EIT Health-landcoördinator voor Nederland, gericht op startups verbonden aan universiteiten en academische ziekenhuizen in life sciences, groene chemie en agrifood.
